hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print((d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/backend/vendor/*) ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/backend/*.php) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" && ./vendor/bin/pint --quiet "$f" 2>/dev/null ;; esac; true

f=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print((d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or '')" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/node_modules/*|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/dist/*) ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/*.js|"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/*.jsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && { out=$(./node_modules/.bin/eslint --no-warn-ignored "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; } ;; esac; true
